item.title: Mac Notes — Parallels Input Switching, homebrew, Archive Utility
item.description: Things that blocked me on a Mac and how they got fixed: mapping Command+Space for Korean/English switching inside Parallels, installing homebrew, and Archive Utility silently refusing to unzip files whose names start with a digit.
